title: explainer diagrams/sequence data
description: Lifelines + ordered message arrows. Validated by render.mjs against the same built-ins-only subset lib/schema.mjs interprets (type, minLength, minItems, properties, required, additionalProperties, items) — see core/diagrams/sequence/README.md.

title.description: Diagram <title>, for accessibility; falls back to "Sequence diagram".

actors.description: Lifeline columns, left to right in array order.

steps.description: Message arrows, drawn top to bottom in array order.

label.description: The message; wraps to the width between from/to.

note.description: Muted annotation drawn below the arrow.

dashed.description: Draws the arrow dashed (a return/async message, by convention).

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the step a clickable node.
